name: recovery_check
_about: Lane A2 part 3: drives straight into the slab's vertical face at (34, -30) hard enough to jam the chassis nose-first against it (grounded_legs stayed 4/4 throughout when this was calibrated -- a different, milder situation than the documented < 2 legs freeze in results/A2.md, but a real jam: it sat frozen until the right input, holding move_forward with the wrong action name (or reverse with the wrong action name) never moves it, only real move_back input does), then reverses. Regression coverage that ramming an obstacle and reversing away still works cleanly: 4/4 legs grounded, roll back under 2 deg, moving at speed within about 4 s. tools/bot_run.sh recovery_check --timeout=45
